display_name: Qualify Claude Code filesystem session source
description: Run a bounded source-local proof for the already-consented Claude Code filesystem session source. The qualifier verifies an enabled source row exists, runs exactly one synchronous poll of that row, then reads one source-filtered session timeline. It returns no transcript, event payload, path, credential, or third-party content: only {source_registered, source_kind, backfill_count, sample_content_retrieved}. A failed precondition or empty backfill is a failed qualification, not a successful empty result.
embedding_description: Qualify the already-consented local Claude Code transcript filesystem source after setup or repair. Verify that an enabled source row exists, one bounded source-specific poll persists events, and a source-filtered session timeline has retrievable content. Return only boolean proof fields and an event count, never transcript text, filesystem paths, credentials, or third-party payloads.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Bounded source-local proof with registration, persisted-event count, and content-retrieval boolean.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report the four proof fields exactly. Do not request, quote, or display the sampled timeline content.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Qualification fails if no enabled source row is registered, its synchronous poll fails or persists zero events, or no source-filtered timeline event has retrievable content.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use the operator-approved session-source registration/hydration path, then retry. Do not bypass filesystem-root authorization or substitute a ledger-wide search for this source-local proof.
